sections.heading: Access on compassionate grounds
sections.text:
When you can access super early on compassionate grounds, what you need to do, and how to apply.

Info Alert

Christmas and new year closure

Our offices close at noon AEDT on 24 December 2026 and reopen on 4 January 2027.

You can still submit compassionate release of super (CRS) applications during this period.

We'll process any CRS applications that haven't been finalised by the time our offices close when we reopen.
